records.name: Pi Durable
records.one_liner: A separate experimental task/checkpoint runtime over pi-ai, with explicit safe-versus-unsafe tool recovery.
used_by: pi-env integrates with its ExecutionEnv contract

features_notes.subagents: Custom durable conversation/task orchestration; subagent examples rather than a shipped task tool.
features_notes.approvals: beforeTool host gate, no approval modes/UI.
features_notes.durable_resume: Native checkpoints; unsafe tool intents settle interrupted, safe tools can rerun; host must wake/resume workers.

dims.loop: Each generation/tool/compaction is a durable task; it does not wrap pi-agent-core.
dims.providers: pi-ai Models directly, including deferred provider responses.
dims.tools: Built-in coding tools, custom tasks, codemode and deferred tool search.
dims.context: Transcript prompt diffs, context cache and durable compaction tasks.
dims.state: Single-writer transactional checkpoint store; unsafe effects are not automatically rerun, safe effects can repeat.
dims.safety: Tool filters and hooks; host ExecutionEnv owns isolation and permissions.
dims.extensibility: Tools, sections, wrappers, registry reload and versioned custom durable tasks.
dims.multi_agent: Ownership trees, joins, cancellation and background task boundaries; host builds agent-facing delegation.
dims.surfaces: In-process SDK; SQLite/JSONL/memory and Cloudflare storage adapter, no product UI/server.
dims.observability: Committed-state observation, task graph, inspect and usage ledger; no integrated OTel pipeline.

key_insights: A separate experimental task/checkpoint runtime over pi-ai, with explicit safe-versus-unsafe tool recovery.
Single-writer transactional checkpoint store; unsafe effects are not automatically rerun, safe effects can repeat.
Tool filters and hooks; host ExecutionEnv owns isolation and permissions.

checked_claims: Durable does not depend on agent-core
Safe recovery requires persisted and current safe flags
Unsafe recovery settles interrupted rather than rerunning
Tool memo and nested-call recovery setup
No alarm/setAlarm implementation in durable src
corrections: Qualified every-task-resumes claim for unsafe and abandon-on-restart paths
Separated admission deduplication from external exactly-once effects
Rephrased at-most-once as a runtime dispatch policy rather than a remote-effects guarantee
unresolved: No crash-injection tests run; correctness beyond sampled static paths remains unproven.
Cloudflare wake-up must be arranged by the host.
verification.scope: Static inspection of selected high-impact claims. Not an exhaustive claim audit; no cloned code executed. Manifest/loop/recovery/safety boundaries prioritized.
